reg_deadline.en: Registration closed Monday, October 5, 2026. Arkansas has no same-day or Election Day registration. Already registered in Arkansas and moved to another county? Contact your county clerk. Transfers of registered voters can be received until the polls close on November 3.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el lunes 5 de octubre de 2026. Arkansas no tiene registro el mismo día ni el Día de las Elecciones. ¿Ya estás registrado en Arkansas y te mudaste a otro condado? Comunícate con el secretario de tu condado (county clerk). Los traslados de votantes registrados se pueden recibir hasta que cierren las urnas el 3 de noviembre.
reg_deadline.quote: NO LATER THAN POLLS CLOSE Deadline for the county clerk to receive county to county transfer of registered voters allowed to vote in the election. Arkansas Constitution, Amendment 51 § 10(b)(2)(B); Act 372 of 2025

mail_request.en: Mail, fax and email applications closed Tuesday, October 27. If you qualify to vote absentee, you, a designated bearer or a care facility administrator can still hand in an application at your county clerk's office until close of business Friday, October 30. Or vote early in person through 5 p.m. Monday, November 2.
mail_request.es: Las solicitudes por correo, fax y correo electrónico cerraron el martes 27 de octubre. Si cumples los requisitos para votar en ausencia, tú, un portador designado (designated bearer) o el administrador de un centro de cuidado todavía pueden entregar una solicitud en la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) hasta el cierre de oficina del viernes 30 de octubre. O vota por anticipado en persona hasta las 5 p. m. del lunes 2 de noviembre.
mail_request.quote: Deadline for county clerk to receive in-person applications for absentee ballots for the General Election from the voter, designated bearer, or administrator is no later than the close of regular business hours on the Friday before the election.
mail_request.en_after: Absentee applications by mail and in person are closed. Vote early in person through 5 p.m. on Monday, November 2, or at the polls on Election Day. A voter who is medically unable to get to the polls can still apply through an authorized agent until 1:30 p.m. on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes de boleta de voto en ausencia por correo y en persona ya cerraron. Vota por anticipado en persona hasta las 5 p. m. del lunes 2 de noviembre, o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones. Un votante que por razones médicas no puede ir a votar todavía puede pedir su boleta por medio de un agente autorizado (authorized agent) hasta la 1:30 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones.

mail_return.en: A mailed ballot must reach your county clerk's office by 7:30 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Delivering it yourself or by a designated bearer? That deadline is close of business Friday, October 30. You can't fax or email a ballot. Military and overseas ballots count if the clerk gets them by 5 p.m. Friday, November 13.
mail_return.es: Una boleta por correo debe llegar a la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) a más tardar a las 7:30 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. ¿La entregas tú o un portador designado (designated bearer)? El plazo es el cierre de oficina del viernes 30 de octubre. No puedes mandar la boleta por fax ni por correo electrónico. Las boletas militares y del extranjero cuentan si el secretario las recibe a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 13 de noviembre.
mail_return.quote: Deadline for the voter, designated bearer or administrator to personally deliver absentee ballots to the county clerk is no later than the close of regular business hours on the Friday before the election. ... 7:30 pm – Deadline for county clerk to receive absentee ballots by mail (excluding military and overseas) ... Must be received by the county clerk by 5:00 pm, ten (10) calendar days after the election.
mail_return.en_after: A mailed ballot must reach your county clerk's office by 7:30 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. You can't fax or email a ballot. Military and overseas ballots count if the clerk gets them by 5 p.m. Friday, November 13.
mail_return.es_after: Una boleta por correo debe llegar a la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) a más tardar a las 7:30 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. No puedes mandar la boleta por fax ni por correo electrónico. Las boletas militares y del extranjero cuentan si el secretario las recibe a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 13 de noviembre.

early_hours.en: Vote early Monday to Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., or Saturday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Early voting ends at 5 p.m. on Monday, November 2. Off-site early voting hours can vary by county, so check with your county clerk.
early_hours.es: Vota por anticipado de lunes a viernes de 8 a. m. a 6 p. m., o el sábado de 10 a. m. a 4 p. m. La votación anticipada termina a las 5 p. m. del lunes 2 de noviembre. El horario de los lugares de votación anticipada fuera de la oficina del condado puede variar, así que pregunta en la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk).
early_hours.quote: During a preferential primary or a general election, early voting is available between the hours of 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday through Friday, and 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Saturday, ending at 5 p.m. on the Monday before the election. Off-site early voting hours may vary by county; watch your local newspaper or contact your county clerk for information.
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended at 5 p.m. on November 2. Vote at your polling site on Election Day, 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó a las 5 p. m. del 2 de noviembre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, de 7:30 a. m. a 7:30 p. m.

cure.notes: No absentee ballot cure process found on sos.arkansas.gov or in the SBEC 2026 Poll Worker Guide.

in_person.en: In most counties you vote early at the county clerk's office. Counties with other early voting sites announce them in local newspapers. On Election Day, you vote at the polling site your county election commission assigns, based on where you live.
in_person.es: En la mayoría de los condados votas por anticipado en la oficina del secretario del condado (county clerk). Los condados con otros lugares de votación anticipada los anuncian en los periódicos locales. El Día de las Elecciones votas en el lugar que te asigna la comisión electoral de tu condado, según dónde vives.
in_person.quote: In most counties, early voting is conducted at the county clerk’s office.

first_time.en: Sent in your registration? You're registered once your county clerk sends you an acknowledgment. No voter ID card from your county clerk yet? Follow up with them before Election Day.
first_time.es: ¿Ya mandaste tu registro? Quedas registrado cuando la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) te manda una confirmación. ¿Todavía no te llega tu tarjeta de votante de esa oficina? Pregunta ahí antes del Día de las Elecciones.
first_time.quote: Before considering yourself a registered voter, you must receive an acknowledgment of your registration from the county clerk.

rule.en: Your county election commission assigns your polling site based on where you live. A voter ID card from your county clerk may show your precinct, and the Secretary of State's voter lookup (Voter View) shows your polling place.
rule.es: La comisión electoral de tu condado te asigna tu lugar de votación según dónde vives. La tarjeta de votante que te manda la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) puede mostrar tu precinto, y el buscador de votantes de la Secretaría de Estado (Voter View) muestra tu lugar de votación.
rule.quote: Your precinct is determined by where you live and the polling site is assigned by your county election commission.

en: Arkansas driver's license or photo ID card, including the digital version in the Arkansas Mobile ID app
Student or employee ID from a college, university or trade school in Arkansas
Public assistance ID card with your photo
Voter ID card with your photo from your county clerk
es: Licencia de conducir o tarjeta de identificación con foto de Arkansas, incluida la versión digital en la app Arkansas Mobile ID
Licencia para portar armas ocultas (concealed carry handgun license)
Identificación de estudiante o empleado de una universidad o escuela técnica (trade school) de Arkansas
Tarjeta de asistencia pública con tu foto
Tarjeta de votante con foto de la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk)
accepted.quote: An Arkansas driver's license or photo identification card (may be in digital form through the Arkansas Mobile ID app); A concealed carry handgun license; A U.S. passport; A U.S. military ID document; A student or employee ID card issued by a postsecondary educational institution, or issued by a trade school in the State of Arkansas; A public assistance ID card with photo; or A voter ID card, with photo, issued by the county clerk.

expired.en: Your ID can be expired up to four years before Election Day.
expired.es: Tu identificación puede tener hasta cuatro años de vencida antes del Día de las Elecciones.
expired.quote: If displaying an expiration date, is not expired or expired no more than four (4) years before the date of the election in which the voter seeks to vote.

without.en: No ID with you? You can vote a provisional ballot. To have it counted, bring an accepted ID to your county election commission or county clerk by noon on Monday, November 9, 2026. Don't have an ID at all? Ask your county clerk for a free voter verification card. You'll sign a statement that you don't have an ID and bring papers that show your full legal name, birth date and home address.
without.es: ¿No traes identificación? Puedes votar con una boleta provisional. Para que cuente, lleva una identificación aceptada a la comisión electoral de tu condado o al secretario de tu condado (county clerk) a más tardar al mediodía del lunes 9 de noviembre de 2026. ¿No tienes ninguna identificación? Pide al secretario de tu condado una tarjeta gratuita de verificación de votante (voter verification card). Firmarás una declaración de que no tienes identificación y llevarás documentos con tu nombre legal completo, tu fecha de nacimiento y tu domicilio.
without.quote: The voter returns to the county board of election commissioners or the county clerk by 12:00 noon on the Monday following the election and presents a document or identification card meeting the requirements described above ... To obtain this voter verification card, voters will be required to complete an affidavit stating they do not possess such identification, and must provide documentation containing their full legal name and date of birth, as well as documentation containing their name and residential address.

who.en: You can vote absentee in Arkansas if you:
who.es: Puedes votar en ausencia en Arkansas si:
who.quote: To be qualified to vote an absentee ballot, you must meet one of the following criteria:

en: will be unavoidably away from your polling site on Election Day
can't get to your polling site on Election Day because of illness or a physical disability
are in the Uniformed Services or merchant marines, or are the spouse or dependent of a member, and are away because of the member's active duty
live in Arkansas but are temporarily living outside the United States
es: vas a estar fuera de tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones sin poder evitarlo
no puedes ir a tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones por enfermedad o discapacidad física
estás en los servicios uniformados o en la marina mercante, o eres cónyuge o dependiente de un miembro, y estás fuera por el servicio activo de esa persona
vives en Arkansas pero estás temporalmente fuera de Estados Unidos
who_list.quote: You will be unavoidably absent from your polling site on election day, OR

witness.notes: No witness or notary rule for absentee ballots found on sos.arkansas.gov.

dropbox.notes: No drop box information found; the SOS absentee page lists mail, in person, designated bearer and authorized agent as return methods.

gear.en: Leave the campaign shirts, caps and buttons at home. Electioneering isn't allowed inside the polls or within 100 feet of the main entrance voters use, and that includes wearing campaign items. Poll workers will ask you to take them off or cover them.
gear.es: Deja en casa las camisetas, gorras y botones de campaña. No se permite hacer campaña dentro del lugar de votación ni a menos de 100 pies de la entrada principal que usan los votantes, y eso incluye llevar artículos de campaña. Los trabajadores electorales te pedirán que te los quites o los cubras.
gear.quote: Electioneering includes 1) handing out literature on any candidate or issue on the ballot, 2) soliciting signatures on any petition, 3) soliciting contributions, and 4) attempting to win votes by wearing or displaying campaign buttons, caps, shirts, signs, or other articles of influence

phone.en: Neither the state poll worker guide nor the Secretary of State's pages we read say anything about phones or photos at the polls. Arkansas does keep a 6-foot privacy zone around voting booths, so don't photograph other voters or their ballots, and ask a poll worker before you take any photo inside.
phone.es: Ni la guía estatal para trabajadores electorales ni las páginas de la Secretaría de Estado que leímos dicen nada sobre celulares o fotos en el lugar de votación. Arkansas sí mantiene una zona de privacidad de 6 pies alrededor de las cabinas de votación, así que no les tomes fotos a otros votantes ni a sus boletas, y pregunta a un trabajador electoral antes de tomar cualquier foto adentro.
phone.quote: A 6-foot privacy zone around voting booths be observed [A.C.A. § 7-5- 310(a)(2)(C)].

line.en: If you're in line at 7:30 p.m., you can still vote.
line.es: Si estás en la fila a las 7:30 p. m., todavía puedes votar.
line.quote: Allow persons already in line at 7:30 p.m. to vote.

tradition.notes: No I voted sticker contest or statewide sticker found on sos.arkansas.gov.

more.en: Two students drew the county's 2026 I Voted stickers: Madi, a 9th grader, and Russell, a 5th grader, whose sticker shows a singing bird on a blossoming branch.
more.es: Dos estudiantes dibujaron los stickers I Voted 2026 del condado: Madi, de 9.º grado, y Russell, de 5.º grado, cuyo sticker muestra un pájaro que canta en una rama en flor.
more.en_after: Two students drew the county's 2026 I Voted stickers: Madi, a 9th grader, and Russell, a 5th grader, whose sticker shows a singing bird on a blossoming branch.
more.es_after: Dos estudiantes dibujaron los stickers I Voted 2026 del condado: Madi, de 9.º grado, y Russell, de 5.º grado, cuyo sticker muestra un pájaro que canta en una rama en flor.
more.notes: Table heading quoted; rows under it read "Madi Brannan / 9th Grade" and "Russell Wollenzien / 5th Grade" with both designs. Schools and the distribution sentence are on a contest page that now returns Page Not Found, so left out. Mockingbird and apple blossom per nwaonline Oct 28 (news only); described here from the image.

provisional.en: If your name isn't on the list, you can't meet the ID rules, or a poll watcher challenges your vote, you can vote a provisional ballot after signing a statement that you're eligible. You'll be told in writing whether it counted, and why if it didn't.
provisional.es: Si tu nombre no aparece en la lista, no puedes cumplir con la regla de identificación o un observador impugna tu voto, puedes votar con una boleta provisional después de firmar una declaración de que puedes votar. Te dirán por escrito si se contó y, si no, por qué.
provisional.quote: If you cast a Provisional Ballot, you have the right to be informed in writing of whether or not your ballot was counted and, if not, the reason it was not counted.

line.en: You can still vote. Poll workers let everyone already in line at 7:30 p.m. vote.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Los trabajadores electorales dejan votar a todas las personas que ya están en la fila a las 7:30 p. m.
line.quote: Allow persons already in line at 7:30 p.m. to vote.

track.en: Look yourself up on VoterView, the Secretary of State's voter lookup. It shows your ballot statuses along with your address and polling place.
track.es: Búscate en VoterView, la herramienta de consulta de votantes de la Secretaría de Estado. Muestra el estado de tus boletas, además de tu dirección y tu lugar de votación.
track.quote: Confirm your address, party association, ballot statuses, and polling place locations.
track.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Arkansas.gov service description names an 'Arkansas Absentee Ballot Search' (Perplexity lead, not read).

late_mail.en: It may be. Your county clerk must receive a mailed ballot by 7:30 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, and a postmark doesn't count. Delivering it yourself or by a designated bearer? That deadline is close of business on Friday, October 30. If you're a patient in a hospital or nursing home, an authorized agent can deliver it by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day. Not sure? Check with your county clerk.
late_mail.es: Puede que sí. El secretario de tu condado (county clerk) debe recibir la boleta por correo a más tardar a las 7:30 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no cuenta. ¿La vas a entregar tú o un portador designado (designated bearer)? La fecha límite es el cierre de la oficina el viernes 30 de octubre. Si estás internado en un hospital o en un centro de cuidado (nursing home), un agente autorizado (authorized agent) puede entregarla hasta las 7:30 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. ¿Tienes dudas? Pregúntale al secretario de tu condado.
late_mail.quote: Deadline for Delivery of Voted Ballot to County Clerk: In Person: by close of business the Friday BEFORE the election. By Designated Bearer: by close of business the Friday BEFORE the election. By Mail: received at clerks office by 7:30 p.m. ON election day By Authorized Agent: by 7:30 p.m. ON election day
late_mail.en_after: It may be. Your county clerk must receive a mailed ballot by 7:30 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, and a postmark doesn't count. Delivery in person or by a designated bearer closed at close of business on Friday, October 30. If you're a patient in a hospital or nursing home, an authorized agent can deliver it by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day. Not sure? Check with your county clerk.
late_mail.es_after: Puede que sí. El secretario de tu condado (county clerk) debe recibir la boleta por correo a más tardar a las 7:30 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no cuenta. La entrega en persona o por un portador designado (designated bearer) cerró al cierre de la oficina el viernes 30 de octubre. Si estás internado en un hospital o en un centro de cuidado (nursing home), un agente autorizado (authorized agent) puede entregarla hasta las 7:30 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. ¿Tienes dudas? Pregúntale al secretario de tu condado.
late_mail.notes: Pass 3 Oct 30, read by curl. The SOS general FAQ (sos.arkansas.gov/frequently-asked-questions) now agrees: in person and designated bearer 'By close of business the Friday before the election', authorized agent 'By 7:30 p.m. on election day'. The pass 2 conflict (FAQ said the day before, and 7:30 p.m. for bearers) is gone. The absentee page ties authorized agents to an affidavit 'from the administrative head of a hospital or nursing home' that the applicant is a patient. Garrett's call (earlier deadline plus check with the county clerk) applied.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 with curl: sos.arkansas.gov Voting in Arkansas, Absentee Voting, FAQ categories 65, 67, 71 and 72, the 2026 Election Calendar (Rev. June 2025, still the one linked from sos.arkansas.gov/elections), the 2020 Voter Rights PDF, and the SBEC 2026 Poll Worker Guide (10-28-25). EARLY VOTING DATES FOR THE LEAD (states.js has AR unchecked): Monday, October 19 to Monday, November 2, 2026. Weekdays 8 a.m. to 6 p.m., Saturdays 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., ending 5 p.m. Monday, November 2. Sources: (1) https://www.sos.arkansas.gov/uploads/elections/2026_Election_Calendar_Rev._6-2025_.pdf: 'October 19, 2026 – Monday 15 DAYS PRIOR TO THE GENERAL ELECTION Early voting begins for General Election between the hours of 8:00 am and 6:00 pm, Monday through Friday, and 10:00 am to 4:00 pm on Saturday. Early voting ends at 5:00 pm on the Monday prior to the election.' and 'November 2, 2026 – Monday ... Last day for voter to participate in early voting. Early voting closes at 5:00 pm on the Monday before the election.' (2) https://www.sos.arkansas.gov/elections/voter-information/voter-registration-information/voting-in-arkansas: the hours quote in dates.early_hours. Suggested states.js note: 'Most counties hold early voting at the county clerk's office.' LOCATOR HOST REJECTED: the SOS links its polling place lookup ('Arkansas Voter View', shown as www.voterview.org) to https://www.voterview.ar-nova.org/voterview; the validator does not accept www.voterview.ar-nova.org, so where.locator_url and mail.track_url are left out. CONFLICTS (left out of the file): (a) in-person absentee APPLICATION deadline: the SOS Absentee Voting page says 'In Person: by close of business the Friday BEFORE the election.' and the 2026 calendar says 'Deadline for county clerk to receive in-person applications for absentee ballots ... no later than the close of regular business hours on the Friday before the election.' (October 30), but SOS FAQ 67 says 'What is the In-Person application deadline for Absentee Voting? By the close of the business day before the election.' (b) in-person BALLOT delivery: the Absentee page says 'In Person: by close of business the Friday BEFORE the election.' and the calendar agrees (October 30), but SOS FAQ 72 says 'What is the In-Person deadline for Delivery of Voted Ballot to County Clerk? By close of business the day before the election.' (c) designated bearer ballot delivery: Absentee page 'By Designated Bearer: by close of business the Friday BEFORE the election.' vs FAQ 67 'By 7:30 p.m. on election day.' The FAQ pages carry internal editing notes ('Mentions “Administrator” here. Can we define?'), so they read as unfinished, but they are live official pages; the file states only the mail deadlines, where all three sources agree. Provisional ID: the Voting in Arkansas page says 'until the Monday after the election'; FAQ 71 and the calendar say noon on that Monday (November 9); the file uses noon. Phone rule, witness rule, drop boxes, cure, tracker and sticker tradition not found. Oct 28 pass: re-read the 2026 calendar (Rev. June 2025, statute-cited) for the Friday, October 30 in-person application and hand-delivery deadlines, the 1:30 p.m. Election Day authorized-agent application deadline, the November 13 military and overseas receipt deadline and county-to-county transfers through close of polls; FAQ 67 and 72 still say 'the day before the election' for in-person deadlines, so the calendar's statute citations (Ark. Code 7-5-404(a)(3)(A), 7-5-411(a)(1)(C)) were followed. ID list from the SBEC 2026 Poll Worker Guide (adds Mobile ID and trade school IDs). Washington County sticker contest page (washingtoncountyar.gov) returned 403 to curl and WebFetch and is blocked for Chrome reading; sticker.tradition stays missing.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7:30 a. m. a 7:30 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: November 3, 2026 General Election Day - Polls open 7:30 am to 7:30 pm
